text:
3 former Western Boone High School athletes listed on college rosters for week ending September 6
By
F. M. PerezThree former Western Boone High School athletes appear on college rosters for the week ending September 6. Senior Elena Gubera is on the Lewis women's volleyball roster, which hosts Concordia-St. Paul on September 4.
All three are listed in women's volleyball, representing Butler, Lewis and Wake Forest. Those teams have nine scheduled events during the week ending September 6.
Each athlete's college team and scheduled events appear below.
Former Western Boone High School Athletes Scheduled for College Action — Week Ending September 6
Elena Gubera
Lewis women's volleyball — GLVC
Schedule: Hosts Concordia-St. Paul on September 4 in Denver, CO; Hosts Palm Beach Atlantic on September 4 in Denver, CO; Hosts Day Two on September 5 in Denver, CO
Raegan Durbin
Butler women's volleyball — Big East
Schedule: Hosts Youngstown State on September 3 in Indianapolis, IN; Hosts Akron on September 4 in Indianapolis, IN; Hosts Ohio on September 5 in Indianapolis, IN
Sadie Poeck
Wake Forest women's volleyball — ACC
Schedule: Hosts Davidson on September 4 in Winston-Salem, NC; Hosts Central Florida on September 5 in Winston-Salem, NC; Hosts Georgetown on September 6 in Winston-Salem, NC
